metadata_caption: Yes, they've already picked the Rockefeller Center's giant Christmas tree for 2023. The tree is coming from Vestal, N.Y., is 80 to 85 years old, weighs 12 tons and is about 80 feet tall and 43 feet wide. It will land at Rockefeller Center Plaza on Nov. 11 #rockefellercenter #rockefellerchristmastree #christmas #christmastree #nyc #newyork
